body:
Unlimited Pixelmon Progression — No Level Cap
Take full control of your Pixelmon journey with this powerful utility mod that removes all level cap restrictions, freeing your Pokémon to grow beyond the standard limits and reach their true potential.
No More Level Cap
Tired of hitting a wall in your Pixelmon progression? This mod completely removes the default level cap, allowing your Pixelmon to grow as far as your dedication takes them. Whether you're grinding through dungeons, competing in intense battles, or simply exploring a vast modded world, your Pixelmon will never stop leveling up. Push your team to their absolute limits and discover just how powerful they can truly become with nothing holding them back.
Built for Every Type of Player
Whether you're a casual explorer or a hardcore competitive trainer, this mod enhances your experience without disrupting the core Pixelmon gameplay you love. Simply install, load your world, and watch as the ceiling disappears entirely — your Pixelmon are now free to grow without restriction.
Perfect For:


Seamless & Lightweight
No complicated setup. No conflicting mechanics. Just a clean, seamless integration that removes the level cap and gets out of your way so you can focus on what matters — training the most powerful Pixelmon team imaginable.
No caps. No limits. Just pure, uninterrupted Pixelmon progression.
